query: 反歧视政策 反歧视政策 衡量企业在招聘、晋升、薪酬及日常管理中，针对消除基于性别、种族、年龄、残疾、宗教等特征歧视的承诺、规则与执行机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：明确界定了受保护的多元特征（包含但不限于性别、民族、生理状况等）；且规定了面向全员的反歧视/DEI 专项培训要求。 • 1分（合格）：有正式的反歧视声明或包含在员工手册中，具备基础的公平雇佣承诺。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关政策披露，或仅有笼统的“依法合规雇佣”表述。 二、执行机制得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：具备匿名举报热线；有明确的违规调查处理流程。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：缺乏明确的举报渠道或未说明处理机制。 • 0分（无覆盖）：未采取实质性的合规管理行动。 反歧视政策 禁止就业歧视 受保护特征 公平雇佣声明 反歧视培训 无意识偏见培训 歧视投诉 歧视调查处理 多元与共融 anti-discrimination policy non-discrimination in employment protected characteristics equal employment opportunity employment discrimination anti-discrimination training unconscious bias training discrimination complaint discrimination investigation diversity and inclusion 企业是否有正式反歧视政策或公平雇佣声明？ 明确保护哪些特征（性别、种族、年龄、残疾、宗教等）？ 是否要求全员反歧视/DEI培训？ 是否有匿名举报热线或投诉渠道？ 违规调查与处理流程是什么？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '反歧视政策'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否有正式反歧视政策或公平雇佣声明？ 明确保护哪些特征（性别、种族、年龄、残疾、宗教等）？ 是否要求全员反歧视/DEI培训？ 是否有匿名举报热线或投诉渠道？ 违规调查与处理流程是什么？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“依法合规雇佣”口号；仅有多元化人数统计而无政策；仅有客户反歧视营销政策；仅有反骚扰但完全不涉及雇佣歧视时可谨慎区分；区分：反歧视政策关注禁止基于特定特征的歧视及合规执行；平等机会措施关注选拔流程公平与监控指标；员工申诉机制是通用渠道， alone 不能证明存在反歧视政策。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE MANAGEMENT / Materiality identification and communication
results.text: During the Reporting Period, Ju Teng International strictly complied with the 'Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China' to protect the fair competition market and stop unfair competition practices. Meanwhile, we remain committed to managing our business practices in accordance with the 'Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) Code of Conduct', and require that the management and all employees strictly abide by it. We have established this Code as a programmatic document to achieve the Company's professional ethics, honest operation and compliance goals. Ju Teng International had not provided trainings on ethics and anti-corruption for employees during the year due to the COVID-19 pandemic. In accordance with this Code, we have formulated the internal 'Business Ethics Management Procedure' to strictly manage the business ethics of our employees. We continue to provide channels such as telephone hotlines and emails for anyone to report corruption and immorality of our employees in real names or anonymously.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE OPERATION / Mutual success with customers
results.text: Customer opinions are vital to the development of Ju Teng International. The Group has established 'Customer Complaint Handling', 'Customer Complaint Handling Procedure' and 'Corrective and Preventive Measures Control Procedure' to standardise the handling process of customer complaints in each Production Plant, and has set up the Quality Assurance Centre under all Production Plants (hereinafter referred to the 'Quality Assurance Centre') to retain the back-end customers. The Quality Assurance Centre receives customer complaints mainly through phone, email, written quality complaint form, business department or other means. After receiving customer feedback, the Quality Assurance Centre is required to communicate with the customer as soon as possible to confirm the details of defective products, clarify the defective situation and defective rate of the products, or visit the customer for confirmation.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITY FOR ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION
results.text: Ju Teng International always encourages each Production Plant to fully utilise its own advantages and resources to develop and build new energy projects such as photovoltaic power generation. During the Reporting Period, the Compal Production Plant continued to utilise the unused vacant land and roof of the plant for photovoltaic power generation. In 2021, 11,890 MWh of photovoltaic power was generated, saving 1,462 tons of coal equivalent. Clean electricity produced by photovoltaic power plants was used for the Company's production and operation, which reduces the purchased electricity and indirectly reduces the greenhouse gas emissions caused by thermal power generation, with a decrease in emission of 11,316 tons CO 2 .
